title: Preserve the selected file as one argument

context.hint: Keep file paths and custom options intact as individual process arguments.
context.surface: A desktop application runs external tools with a selected file and configurable values.
assumptions: Use local recording stubs and benign inputs.

review.invariant: A selected file is passed verbatim as one argument to the receiving tool.
review.verification: Compare the recorded argument vector for a normal file name containing spaces and punctuation. Check that fixed arguments retain their expected positions.

source_observation.summary: The recording stub received the complete path as one argument after the change. The GUI flow was outside the check.
